articles.title: Trezor warns 14,000 customers after fulfilment partner suffers data breach
articles.snippet: The incident marks the first time Trezor customers' shipping addresses were exposed.

articles.title: Prediction markets should dial back faulty filings for incentives to boost trading: CFTC
articles.snippet: The U.S. regulator of platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket suggests the industry is getting into bad compliance habits that may allow for market abuse.

articles.title: Morgan Stanley's infrastructure partner Zerohash rebuffed in pitch to be U.S. trust bank
articles.snippet: Zerohash, which handles crypto plumbing for Morgan Stanley's E*Trade, said it's planning on re-filing and hoping for a swift resolution.

articles.title: Bitmine’s $257M annualized staking income ‘fills’ operational gaps, share buybacks: analysts
articles.snippet: Bitmine’s Ether staking revenue is an important financial buffer that fills financial gaps and provides recurring revenue streams beyond Ether’s price appreciation, analysts told Cointelegraph.

articles.title: FlightAware drops Kalshi lawsuit one day after filing
articles.snippet: Following the initial lawsuit, at least one of Kalshi’s event contracts was changed to list “Primary Source Agency” as the entity behind verifying flight cancellation data.
